dct_description_sm: The main purpose of recording the date of total ice cover on the lake, the ice thickness during the ice cover period, date of lake ice melting and the duration of the lake ice are twofold. One purpose is to better understand the climatic processes involved as well as the climate itself. The other main purpose is to investigate how the climate effects the lake itself (biologically, physically and chemically).
dct_title_s: The eye of Abisko (Abiskogat) - ice cover
